finding.claim: Cancel guard is inverted: when no cancellation has been requested (!token.reason) it returns early without setting reason, so cancel() never creates a CanceledError.
finding.title: CancelToken cancel never sets reason due to inverted check

verifier.reason: The guard at cancel/CancelToken.js:55 returns early when token.reason is falsy (its initial state), so the assignment at cancel/CancelToken.js:60 is unreachable on first cancel and no CanceledError is created.

finding.claim: isAxiosError uses !== false so any object without isAxiosError (undefined !== false) returns true, misidentifying plain objects as Axios errors.
finding.title: isAxiosError returns true for non-Axios objects

verifier.reason: The function at helpers/isAxiosError.js:13 returns utils.isObject(payload) && payload.isAxiosError !== false, so a plain object lacking the property yields undefined !== false and is classified as an Axios error.

finding.claim: start() overwrites this.timer with new setInterval without clearing existing handle, leaking prior interval on repeated start.
finding.title: scheduler start replaces timer without clearing

verifier.reason: start() at helpers/scheduler.js:7 assigns this.timer = setInterval(callback, intervalMs) without any preceding clearInterval, so a repeated start orphans the prior handle and stop() at helpers/scheduler.js:10 can only clear the latest one.
